cohort: 260 term pregnant women who delivered between 2013 and 2016
finding: Histological chorioamnionitis at term was most prevalent in spontaneous labor, suggesting an association between inflammatory processes and the physiological signals of parturition.
mod_finding: HCA rates differed significantly between spontaneous labor, PROM, induction, and elective cesarean deliveries (49%, 32%, 24%, and 4% respectively, p<0.001).
